thread:
oncall-bot: Pager triggered — P1 — hosted-api /v1/generate — us-west1 — sustained 5xx for 12m (avg 18% 5xx). Link: https://redwood.incidents/1833456789

Taylor: I'm primary for this shift, taking lead. starting investigation now.

Priya: I'll be secondary, monitoring customer comms and dashboards. If Taylor needs a hand with infra ops I can jump in.

Diego: I'm on-call for infra but not paged until 18:00PT. I can prep a scale-up if needed.

Morgan: quick check — I see a spike in backend-nginx 502/504s and traces show KV cache timeouts around gpux-07. Could be overloaded hosts or a kernel OOM.

Taylor: Confirming — gpux-07 CPU at 92%, /var/log/app shows repeated "kv_cache_put timeout". Rolling a temporary routing change to avoid gpux-07. Will also check deployment canary.

Priya: Notifying CS for any active customers hitting higher latency — message sent to #customer-impact :warning: (cc @support).

Taylor: Runbook pointer: https://redwood.runbooks/hosted-api/5xx-incident (see sections "Immediate mitigations" and "Fallback routing").

Taylor: Mitigation steps I'm doing now:
```
# check nginx on host
ssh gpux-07 sudo tail -n 200 /var/log/nginx/error.log
# check kv cache metrics
curl -s http://metrics.internal/kvcache | jq '.hosts["gpux-07"]'
# shift traffic off gpux-07
redwoodctl route set --pool hosted-api --exclude-host gpux-07
```

Morgan: If routing change doesn't reduce errors in 3m we should scale the dedicated pool by +2 GPUs. Diego can trigger autoscale if needed.

Diego: Standing by. If requested I'll run:
```
redwoodctl pool resize --name hosted-api-dedicated --delta 2 --reason "short term P1 scale"
```

Taylor: Done: excluded gpux-07 from pool at 1833457060, error rate dropped to ~4% over the next 90s. Looks like hotspot on that host.

oncall-bot: Automated note — pager acknowledged by Taylor at 1833456910.

Priya: Nice. I'm updating the incident doc and creating follow-up tickets for cleanup and deeper root cause:
- TICK-4827 (host remediation: investigate gpux-07 disk/kernel/oom)
- TICK-4828 (improve KV cache circuit breaker/alerts)
- TICK-4829 (add runbook step to auto-exclude CPU-hot hosts)

Taylor: Created INC-3421 for the P1 (link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-3421). Short summary: gpux-07 KV cache timeouts => 5xx spike; mitigated by routing exclusion.

Priya: Handoff plan: Taylor will remain primary for the next 30m to monitor stabilization, then I'll take over at 08:00PT to handle any customer comms and triage tickets. Taylor — please post a quick status before you hand off.

Taylor: Will do. Current status at 1833457200: error rate stable ~3.8%, no new host anomalies, logs show recovered kv_put latency.

Morgan: Action: after stabilization, run a postmortem checklist (owner: Priya) and schedule a retro. Suggest 1-hour retro tomorrow 10:00PT — I'll ping calendar.

Priya: Assigned owners:
- Postmortem doc (Priya) -> INC-3421
- Host remediation (Diego) -> TICK-4827
- Runbook updates (Taylor) -> TICK-4829
- Monitoring alerts tuning (Morgan) -> TICK-4828

Taylor: Handing over to Priya at 1833457280. Leaving notes in the incident doc.

Priya: Taking handoff — I'm primary now. Summary for oncall notes: mitigated by excluding gpux-07, created INC-3421, follow-up tickets TICK-4827/4828/4829 created, retro tentative for tomorrow 10:00PT. If any customer escalations come in point them to the incident doc.

sre-bot: Reminder: please run the post-incident checklist and set incident severity/impact in INC-3421.

Priya: Will file the impact assessment (affecting ~4% of requests in us-west1 for ~12m, no data loss). Adding impact to the incident doc now.

Taylor: :thumbsup: Thanks team — nice quick mitigation. Priya, ping me if the error rate climbs back above 7% or if any new hosts surface.

Priya: Copy. Logging final handoff message and scheduling the retro (calendar invite sent).

oncall-bot: Thread closed for handoff tracking. If further pages come in they will create a new thread.
